Famous Tourist Places in Mangaluru – Book Your Sightseeing Cab

Discover Mangaluru's Beaches, Temples & Coastal Attractions

Explore the beauty of coastal Karnataka with Abhi Cabs 24×7 Mangaluru sightseeing taxi services. From sandy beaches and historic temples to family attractions, plan a comfortable sightseeing journey.

  • Panambur Beach

    Visit Panambur Beach, famous for its coastline, sunset views, and beachside activities. Ideal for family outings and relaxing coastal trips.

  • Tannirbhavi Beach

    Enjoy the peaceful surroundings of Tannirbhavi Beach, known for its scenic shoreline and beautiful sunsets. Choose a local cab for a relaxing seaside visit.

  • Kudroli Gokarnanatheshwara Temple

    Visit the famous Kudroli Gokarnanatheshwara Temple, known for its architecture and colourful Dasara celebrations.

  • Kadri Manjunatha Temple

    Explore the historic Kadri Manjunatha Temple, an important spiritual landmark in Mangaluru.

  • Mangaladevi Temple

    Discover the famous Mangaladevi Temple, associated with Mangaluru's history and cultural heritage.

  • Pilikula Nisargadhama

    Plan a family trip to Pilikula Nisargadhama, a popular attraction featuring nature, wildlife, science, and cultural experiences.

  • St. Aloysius Chapel

    Visit St. Aloysius Chapel, known for its beautiful interior paintings and historic architecture.

  • Someshwara Beach

    Explore Someshwara Beach, known for its rocky coastline and scenic surroundings.

Popular One-Day Trip Destinations Near Mangaluru

Explore Coastal Getaways & Temple Tours with Abhi Cabs 24×7

Planning a short getaway? Choose Abhi Cabs 24×7 for one-day trip taxi enquiries from Mangaluru to nearby beaches, temples, heritage sites, and nature destinations.

  • Mangaluru to Udupi

    Visit Udupi, known for Sri Krishna Matha, coastal culture, and nearby beaches. Suitable for temple visits and family outings.

  • Mangaluru to Malpe Beach

    Discover Malpe Beach, a popular coastal destination near Udupi, known for its scenic shoreline and leisure activities.

  • Mangaluru to Kateel Temple

    Plan a spiritual visit to Kateel Sri Durgaparameshwari Temple, located along the Nandini River.

  • Mangaluru to Dharmasthala

    Visit Dharmasthala, home to the famous Sri Manjunatha Temple. A popular destination for pilgrimage and family temple visits.

  • Mangaluru to Kukke Subramanya

    Plan a pilgrimage to Kukke Subramanya Temple, surrounded by the scenic Western Ghats.

  • Mangaluru to Moodbidri

    Discover Moodbidri, famous for its Jain heritage and Thousand Pillar Temple.

  • Mangaluru to Karkala

    Visit Karkala, known for its Gomateshwara statue, Jain monuments, and historic temples.

  • Mangaluru to Mulki

    Explore Mulki, a coastal destination known for river landscapes and outdoor experiences.
